modern: Let no one hear you any longer finding fault with life at court, or with your own.
original: Let no man any longer hear thee finding fault with the court life or with thy own.

explained.summary: Stop complaining about palace life, or about your own life, where anyone can hear. Marcus is telling himself that grumbling about his circumstances is beneath him, whatever they are.
explained.today: The modern court is the office, the family WhatsApp or the school-gate crowd. Moaning about it to anyone who’ll listen rarely helps and quietly sours the mood for everyone.
